ei.title: The Power of COLORS in Movies
ei.subject: 영어2

fullPassage: Colors are an important aspect of films. They look visually attractive and can be used to convey various emotions and messages to the audience. Film directors carefully select colors like bright yellow to bring a sense of hope, calm blue for peace, and intense red for violence. These color choices are not random; they are intentionally made to impact your experience while you watch the film, even if you don’t consciously notice them. Below are several outstanding examples of how skillfully film directors can use color to add richness to the story and evoke specific emotions from the audience. Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. It was the red coat of a single lost girl, alone in a crowd of frightened Jews. As such, it was the strong contrast of colors that enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. The young girl represents innocence while also representing the violence of the Nazis. So, what happened to this young girl? The movie never tells us for sure, but later in the film we see a dead girl in a red coat being loaded into a cart. Colors strengthen the emotions of viewers due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions. An excellent example can be found in an animated film where an ordinary citizen becomes a superhero to defeat a villain. At the beginning of the film, the male character, who was once a superhero but had to return to living an ordinary life, is surrounded by dull colors and gray tones. He is working as if he were an ordinary person, hiding his true power. However, when he returns to work as a superhero, the film fills up with bold reds, yellows, and blues. These colors represent power and happiness. This shift reflects his emotional development, and viewers can grasp his mood without words. Through such a process, colors impact the emotional experience of the audience. Colors help audiences grasp the connections between characters, places, and important objects in films, making complex stories easier to understand. There is a film from the 1930s that shows the adventures of a girl attempting to return home after being swept away in a flash by a tornado to a land of magic. The director uses colors to effectively communicate with the audience. The girl’s life in a boring village is shown in black and white, and the world of magic is expressed in various colors in the movie. With such color differences, the audience can distinguish which world the events take place in. Audiences watching this film are immersed in the world of magic as if they were the girl when watching the scenes that turn to color in a flash. Film directors capture the changes in their characters’ lives through changes in color. Another film from the 1990s follows the dramatic experience of a man with scissor hands who comes down to a town to live with ordinary folks. He always wears black, and the castle where he used to live was a gray and gloomy place. However, in the town where he came to live with his lover, each house is painted differently, and the people wear colorful clothes. At first, he is welcomed by the people in town, but as he becomes misunderstood and disliked, the film’s colors gradually become darker. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers. Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind like snow. With such changes, the director shows the audience that his life has become much happier. Film directors choose colors to give us the best possible experience. When watching movies, consider why specific colors are used in a scene. You may not know the answer, but your understanding of the film will be deeper.

det.korean: ① attractively → attractive: 감각동사 look의 보어이므로 형용사 attractive
det.analysis:
① attractively → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'They look visually ___'에서 look은 '~해 보이다'라는 감각동사예요. 감각동사 뒤에는 부사가 아니라 형용사가 보어로 와야 해요. 그래서 형용사 attractive(매력적인)로 써야 하고, 부사 attractively로 쓰면 틀려요. (앞의 visually는 attractive를 꾸미는 부사라 맞아요.) ❌ attractively는 틀림 ←정답

② notice: 'even if you don’t consciously notice them'에서 don’t 뒤라 동사원형 notice가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ skillfully: 'how skillfully film directors can use color'에서 동사 use를 꾸미는 부사 skillfully가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ add: 'can use color to add richness'에서 'to + 동사원형'의 to부정사라 add가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 감각동사 look + 형용사(보어): look attractive(매력적으로 보이다)

③ hiding: 'He is working ~, hiding his true power'에서 '힘을 숨긴 채로'라는 뜻의 분사구문이라 hiding이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ grasp: 'viewers can grasp his mood'에서 조동사 can 뒤라 동사원형 grasp이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

Film directors carefully select colors like bright yellow to bring a sense of hope, calm blue for peace, and intense red for violence. These color choices are not random; they are intentionally made to impact your experience while you watch the film, even if you don’t consciously notice them. Below are several outstanding examples of how skillfully film directors can use color to add richness to the story and evoke specific emotions from the audience. Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to.

det.analysis:

❌ ② The historical accuracy of films set during the Second World War(제2차 세계 대전을 배경으로 한 영화의 역사적 정확성): 붉은 외투 영화는 예시일 뿐 전쟁 영화의 정확성이 주제가 아님

❌ ③ The technical equipment required to add color to black-and-white films(흑백 영화에 색을 입히는 데 필요한 기술 장비): 기술·장비는 본문에 없음

❌ ④ Why animated movies attract larger audiences than live-action movies(애니메이션 영화가 실사 영화보다 더 많은 관객을 끄는 이유): 본문에서 다루지 않는 비교

questions.passage: Like the saying “<u>A picture is worth a thousand words</u>,” colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. It was the red coat of a single lost girl, alone in a crowd of frightened Jews. As such, it was the strong contrast of colors that enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. The young girl represents innocence while also representing the violence of the Nazis. So, what happened to this young girl?
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 A picture is worth a thousand words가 이 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 색상(이미지)이 말보다 영화의 메시지를 더 강하게 전달할 수 있다는 뜻
det.analysis:
밑줄 속담 'A picture is worth a thousand words(그림 한 장은 천 마디 말의 가치가 있다)'는 바로 뒤 문장 'colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words(색상은 영화의 메시지를 말보다 더 강하게 전달한다)'를 뒷받침하려고 인용된 거예요.

❌ ① 그림을 '그리는 데' 설명이 필요하다는 것은 속담을 글자 그대로 뒤집은 오해예요.

✅ ② 색상 같은 이미지가 말(대사)보다 메시지를 더 강하게 전달한다는 뜻이에요. 글의 흐름과 정확히 일치해요 ←정답

❌ ③ 대사가 많을수록 좋다는 내용은 오히려 글과 반대예요(이미지가 말보다 강함).

❌ ④ 그림과 글이 무관하다는 뜻이 아니라, 그림이 글보다 더 강하다는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: 속담 바로 뒤 'colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words'가 해석의 열쇠입니다.

questions.passage: Colors strengthen the emotions of viewers due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions. An excellent example can be found in an animated film where an ordinary citizen becomes a superhero to defeat a villain. At the beginning of the film, the male character, who was once a superhero but had to return to living an ordinary life, is surrounded by dull colors and gray tones. <u>He</u> is working as if he were an ordinary person, hiding his true power. However, when he returns to work as a superhero, the film fills up with bold reds, yellows, and blues. These colors represent power and happiness. This shift reflects his emotional development, and viewers can grasp his mood without words. Through such a process, colors impact the emotional experience of the audience.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 He가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
밑줄 문장: 'He is working as if he were an ordinary person, hiding his true power.'(그는 자신의 진정한 힘을 숨긴 채 평범한 사람인 것처럼 일하고 있다). 바로 앞 문장 'the male character, who was once a superhero but had to return to living an ordinary life'에서 소개한 '한때 슈퍼히어로였던 남성 캐릭터'를 He가 받아요.

✅ ① 한때 슈퍼히어로였지만 평범한 삶으로 돌아와야 했던 남성 캐릭터: 앞 문장의 바로 그 인물이에요 ←정답

❌ ② 관객들은 He가 아니라 영화를 보는 사람들이에요.

❌ ③ 또 다른 영웅은 본문에 없어요.

❌ ④ 감독은 He가 가리키는 대상이 아니에요.
det.tip: 앞 문장의 the male character(남성 캐릭터)를 He가 받습니다.

ch: 한때 슈퍼히어로였지만 평범한 삶으로 돌아와야 했던 남성 캐릭터

The director uses colors to effectively communicate with the audience. The girl’s life in a boring village is shown in black and white, and the world of magic is expressed in __________ in the movie. With such color differences, the audience can distinguish which world the events take place in. Audiences watching this film are immersed in the world of magic as if they were the girl when watching the scenes that turn to color in a flash.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① complete darkness(완전한 어둠): 마법의 세계를 어둠으로 표현한다는 내용은 없음
❌ ② black and white(흑백): 흑백은 '지루한 마을'을 표현하는 수단이라, 대비되는 마법의 세계에는 맞지 않음(함정)
✅ ③ various colors(다양한 색): 지루한 마을은 흑백으로, 마법의 세계는 '다양한 색'으로 표현된다는 대조 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
❌ ④ total silence(완전한 침묵): 소리가 아니라 색에 관한 문맥이라 맞지 않음
det.tip: boring village = black and white ↔ world of magic = various colors(흑백 vs 다양한 색의 대조)

questions.stem:

"이 색상들은 힘과 행복을 상징한다." (6단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) and, colors, happiness, power, represent, these 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: These colors represent power and happiness
det.analysis:
'이 색상들은 ~을 상징한다'가 문장의 뼈대예요. 주어는 '이 색상들'이라 These colors로, 동사는 '상징한다'라서 represent로 써요. 주어가 복수(colors)라 동사도 복수형 represent 그대로예요: These + colors + represent.

무엇을 상징하는가 하면 '힘과 행복'이에요. '힘'은 power, '행복'은 happiness이고 둘을 and로 이어요: power + and + happiness.

순서대로 이으면 These / colors / represent / power / and / happiness.
det.tip: 주어(These colors) + 동사(represent) + 목적어(power and happiness)

questions.wa: These colors represent power and happiness
accept: These colors represent power and happiness

questions.passage: At first, he is welcomed by the people in town, but as he becomes misunderstood and __________ (dislike), the film’s colors gradually become darker. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: disliked (과거분사, 수동).
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'as he becomes misunderstood and ___'에서 그는 '오해받고 미움받게 되는' 대상이에요. becomes 뒤에 앞의 misunderstood와 and로 이어지는 병렬 자리라, 같은 과거분사 형태로 맞춰야 해요. dislike(싫어하다)를 '미움받는'이라는 수동의 뜻을 가진 과거분사 disliked로 바꿔야 해요. 'becomes misunderstood and disliked(오해받고 미움받게 된다)'가 맞아요.
det.tip: becomes + 과거분사 병렬: misunderstood and disliked(오해받고 미움받는)

다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"그런 과정을 통해, 색상은 관객의 정서적 경험에 영향을 미친다." (12단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) a, audience, colors, emotional, experience, impact, of, process, such, the, the, through 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 12단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: Through such a process, colors impact the emotional experience of the audience
det.analysis:
'그런 과정을 통해'는 문장 앞에 오는 전치사구예요: Through + such + a + process.

이어서 '색상은 ~에 영향을 미친다'가 핵심이에요. 주어는 colors, 동사는 impact(영향을 미치다)예요: colors + impact.

무엇에 영향을 미치는가 하면 '관객의 정서적 경험'이에요. '그 정서적 경험'은 the emotional experience, '관객의'는 of the audience로 이어요: the + emotional + experience + of + the + audience.

순서대로 이으면 Through / such / a / process / colors / impact / the / emotional / experience / of / the / audience.
det.tip: 전치사구(Through such a process) + 주어(colors) + 동사(impact) + 목적어(the emotional experience of the audience)

questions.wa: Through such a process colors impact the emotional experience of the audience
accept: Through such a process colors impact the emotional experience of the audience

Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers. Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind like snow. questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.
"영화를 볼 때, 특정 장면에서 왜 특정 색상이 사용되는지 생각하라."

[ a / are / colors / consider / in / movies / scene / specific / used / watching / when / why ] (12단어) (영어로)

det.korean: When watching movies, consider why specific colors are used in a scene
det.analysis:
'영화를 볼 때'는 '~할 때'라는 뜻의 분사구문으로 시작해요: When + watching + movies.

'생각하라'는 명령문이라 동사원형 consider로 써요: consider.

'왜 특정 색상이 사용되는지'는 '왜 ~한지'라는 간접의문문이에요. 'why + 주어 + 동사' 어순이고, 색상이 '사용되는' 것이라 수동태(are used)로 써요: why + specific + colors + are + used.

'특정 장면에서'는 전치사구로 뒤에 놓아요: in + a + scene.

순서대로 이으면 When / watching / movies / consider / why / specific / colors / are / used / in / a / scene.
det.tip: 분사구문(When watching movies) + 명령문(consider) + 간접의문문(why specific colors are used) + in a scene

questions.wa: When watching movies consider why specific colors are used in a scene
accept: When watching movies consider why specific colors are used in a scene

"그의 얼음 조각상에서 나오는 얼음 가루가 눈처럼 바람에 날린다." (12단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) blows, from, his, ice, ice, in, like, powder, sculpture, snow, the, wind 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 12단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind like snow
det.analysis:
주어는 '얼음 가루'인데, '그의 얼음 조각상에서 나오는'이라는 수식이 붙어요. 주어 ice powder 뒤에 'from his ice sculpture(그의 얼음 조각상에서 나오는)'를 이어요: ice + powder + from + his + ice + sculpture.

동사는 '날린다'예요. 주어 ice powder가 단수라 단수 동사 blows로 써요: blows.

'바람에'는 in the wind, '눈처럼'은 like snow로 문장 끝에 놓아요: in + the + wind + like + snow.

순서대로 이으면 ice / powder / from / his / ice / sculpture / blows / in / the / wind / like / snow.
det.tip: 주어(ice powder from his ice sculpture) + 동사(blows) + in the wind like snow
